We have bulk TiO2 structure (mp-2657) and CO2 molecule (mp-644607). Need to generate slab with Miller index [1,1,1], min slab size 12 Å, vacuum 5 Å. Then select slab index 0 from enumerated slabs. Then identify adsorption sites, choose ontop site index 0, place CO2 at height 2.0 Å above surface. Finally output combined structure CIF file path.

We need to use enumerate_slabs_text, choose_slab_text, get_adsorption_sites_text, choose_adsorption_site_text, add_adsorbate_to_slab_text. Then write final CIF to file.

Proceed stepwise.
